environment.description: EKS cluster running Step Functions workflow integration. The workflow-task-handler pod runs in 'workflow-ns' namespace. Istio sidecar is injected but running in PERMISSIVE mTLS mode. No AuthorizationPolicy resources are applied. The Envoy sidecar passes through both Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding headers without normalization. The payment-processor service in 'payments-ns' uses gunicorn behind an Envoy proxy that prioritizes Transfer-Encoding over Content-Length, enabling CL/TE desync when both headers are present with conflicting values.
